name: Dobrynya
subtitle: The Bold
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Though born of modest peasants, Dobrynya Nikitich rose to become one of Vyraj’s greatest knights. Slayer of dragons, rescuer of princesses, there is no traditional quest he has not undertaken—often complaining throughout, yet succeeding all the same. He performs frequent tasks for Vyraj’s princess, but still they treat him as a commoner, a circumstance he is slowly coming to resent…
